title: Underground cities of Turkey
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Underground cities of Turkey, about ancient at Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This is quite a famous phenomenon in Turkey that there are huge cities. They look like ant farms on an enormous scale that are dug out under the earth.

plain: Graham Hancock, a writer on lost ancient civilisations, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the famous underground cities of Turkey. He describes them as huge cities dug out beneath the earth, looking like ant farms on an enormous scale. He raises them as a sign that ancient people went to great lengths to live underground.
